morgan: perf alert — CI microbench failed on PR 14899 (shadow batcher change). Lots of green checks but perf thresholds tripped. Looks like tokens/sec dropped in the snapshot suite. :warning:

  thresholds:

kai: I reproduced on my laptop with the microbench harness. Not a kernel regression (GPU profiles clean). The slowdown shows up earlier — during batch assembly + kv lookup warmup. Observed KV hit-rate ramp is slower by ~30s. Also saw batch queue depth spike when merge_window_ms increased in the PR.

anya: confirmed — I ran nvprof and kernel timings are almost identical. Flamegraph points to runtime: batcher::assemble_batches -> kv_cache::lookup loop, more syscalls and mutex contention. Probably cross-sequence merges are increasing KV churn.

morgan: PR changed sequence_grouping and doubled merge_window_ms (6ms -> 12ms) to improve packing for long tails. That should help throughput normally but seems to increase prefix collisions on our KV shards.

devops: tagging this PR as rollout-blocked. I'll kick off a bisect over commits abc123..def456 unless you want to narrow it down first. :eyes:

morgan: please bisect. If repro is stable, revert the merge to stop further rollouts. This is blocking a couple of downstream canaries.

devops: queued bisect job (job id: bisect-4301240050). Range: abc123..def456. Will run microbench suite across variants.

kai: quick local patch reduced merge_window_ms back to 6ms and added a sequence-affinity guard; that removes the slow warmup in my runs. I'll push a WIP PR after bisect if that checks out.

ci-bot: bisect started (bisect-4301240050). Will post first failing commit when found.

morgan: I'm rolling back the merged change on main for now to be safe. Revert PR created: revert-14902. Will follow up with bisect results and the repro patch. :thumbsup:

anya: thanks — once bisect finishes I can run a focused kv-shard sim to validate the sequence-affinity guard approach.

bench-bot: note: microbench variance here is low; this looks like a real regression not noise.
